      <details class="card adocs-expand adocs-expand-small component-property" id="datamodelbindings.filetransferid">

          </span>
        </summary>
        <div class="a-collapseContent-inside component-property-details"><div class="component-property-description">Where in the data model the component stores the ID Altinn Broker gave the file transfer, as soon as the transfer is created. <a href="/en/altinn-studio/v9/develop-a-service/reference/data/data-model-bindings/">How to use data model bindings.</a></div></div>
      </details>

      <details class="card adocs-expand adocs-expand-small component-property" id="datamodelbindings.filetransferstatus">
        <summary class="component-property-summary">
          <span class="component-property-chevron" aria-hidden="true"></span>

          </span>
        </summary>
        <div class="a-collapseContent-inside component-property-details"><div class="component-property-description">Where in the data model the component stores the file transfer's status in Altinn Broker: Initialized when the transfer is created, and UploadProcessing or a later status once Broker has the whole file. The form cannot be submitted before then. <a href="/en/altinn-studio/v9/develop-a-service/reference/data/data-model-bindings/">How to use data model bindings.</a></div></div>
      </details>

      <details class="card adocs-expand adocs-expand-small component-property" id="datamodelbindings.filename">

        <div class="a-collapseContent-inside component-property-details"><div class="component-property-description">Where in the data model the component stores the name of the file it sends. <a href="/en/altinn-studio/v9/develop-a-service/reference/data/data-model-bindings/">How to use data model bindings.</a></div></div>
      </details>

    <span class="component-property-summary-meta">

<details class="card adocs-expand adocs-expand-small component-property" id="metadata">
  <summary class="component-property-summary">
    <span class="component-property-chevron" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    <span class="component-property-name" title="metadata">metadata</span>
    <span class="component-property-summary-meta">
      <span class="component-property-required">Optional</span>
      <span class="component-property-type" title="object">Type: <span class="component-property-value">object</span></span>
    </span>
  </summary>
  <div class="a-collapseContent-inside component-property-details"><div class="component-property-description">Metadata sent with the file transfer, as Altinn Broker's property list: at most 10 entries, each key at most 50 characters. A value is fixed text or an expression, such as ["dataModel", "path.to.field"] for something the user filled in. Entries without a value when the file is sent are left out. Additional property names are allowed. Value type: string | expression&lt;string&gt;.</div></div>
</details>

<details class="card adocs-expand adocs-expand-small component-property" id="disablevirusscan">

    </span>
  </summary>
  <div class="a-collapseContent-inside component-property-details"><div class="component-property-description">Sends the file without scanning it for viruses, so the size limit that scanning sets does not apply. Only allowed when the Broker resource is approved for it; otherwise the component shows a configuration error.</div></div>
</details>

A file transfer with virus scan enabled does not support files larger than 50 GB.</div></div>
</details>
